rules.name: Search Engine Discovery of Sensitive Content
rules.description: Detects search engine crawlers accessing sensitive paths like /admin, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin, /backup, /config
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
information_gathering_events
| where information_gathering has_any("wstg", "information-gathering", "reconnaissance", "search-engine")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold
